title: Completion Workflow Rules
purpose: Define the gates required before an AI-assisted task can be reported complete.

rules.statement: Update affected documentation before reporting completion when behavior, setup, architecture, APIs, data models, configuration, deployment, or workflows change.
Update CHANGELOG.md after each completed task or explicitly report why it is not applicable.
Update .ai/requirements/requirements.json when a requirement is added, completed, blocked, or materially changed.
Run the most relevant validation available after changes and report command results.
Run the configured build or rebuild command before marking implementation complete, or explain why it could not be run.
If validation or rebuild fails, mark the task needs_review or blocked and include the failing command and relevant error.
Do not claim success if validation was skipped; explain why it was not run and identify residual risk.

Final output must include summary, completed requirements, pending or blocked requirements, files changed, validation summary, documentation summary, changelog summary, commit entry sentence, and pull request information.
